text:
Anthropic released Claude 4 as two models in May 2025 to target different use cases with distinct pricing structures, positioning the family within a market where agentic coding had become the defining product category of 2025.

The launch signaled that Anthropic was emphasizing safety and reliability for coding agents to compete effectively against OpenAI's o-series during an enterprise "agentic-coding gold rush." This strategy contributed to record API usage driven by Claude Code adoption, which helped cement Anthropic’s position as a leader in this market segment [Source: ev-1].
